title: Priya, 36 — the raise that shrank after leave
caption:
The gap doesn't start at the hire. It starts at the first baby — about 20% of her earnings, long-term (Kleven, AEJ: Applied 2019).
Ask for the written promo criteria (Bohnet, 2016).
Send this to her.
www.aiforheratx.org
#motherhoodpenalty #workingmoms #womenatwork #womenshealth #careerandfamily

phrases: It's the birth, not the hire.

scenes.text: She stopped arguing about vibes and asked for the promotion bar in writing.
phrases: "Can I get the promo criteria in writing?"
Six lines came back. Six things to hit.
Written rules are much harder to bend.

scenes.text: Write 3 things you shipped this quarter, with *dates*. Then go walk after dinner.
phrases: Three wins, with dates, in your notes app.
Bring them to your next 1:1 — documented beats remembered (Iris Bohnet, What Works).
Then a 20-minute walk: WHO says 150 minutes a week, and this is how it adds up.
